description: This PHP source file handles survey display and processing in the SuiteCRM platform. It manages survey validation, fetching survey data, rendering survey questions with various input types, and displaying a closed survey page if applicable.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for displaying the closed survey page.

methods.name: displaySurvey
methods.description: Renders the survey form with questions and submit button.

methods.name: displayQuestion
methods.description: Displays individual survey questions based on their type.

methods.name: displayRadioField
methods.description: Displays radio button options for a question.

methods.name: displayRadioButton
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a single radio button option.

methods.name: displayMultiselectField
methods.description: Displays a multiselect checkbox list for a question.

methods.name: displayScaleField
methods.description: Displays a scale (1-10) radio button input for a question.

methods.name: displayRatingField
methods.description: Displays a star rating dropdown for a question.

methods.name: displayMatrixField
methods.description: Displays a matrix of radio buttons for question options.

methods.name: displayDateTimeField
methods.description: Displays a date and time picker input.

methods.name: displayClosedPage
methods.description: Displays a page indicating the survey is closed.
